(2) Indoors, the woman sits wearing a striped tank top, pressing her temples with an expression of discomfort to indicate a headache. The man, now in a sleeveless white tank top, stands behind her and gently massages her head with both hands. The setting is a minimalist room with a solid gray wall and soft lighting. (3) The couple sits on the floor of a modern living room next to a light gray sofa. The man uses a pink and silver Dyson hair dryer to dry the woman's hair while she sits cross-legged and pets a white fluffy dog. They exchange dialogue, and the woman's facial expression shifts from confusion to pleasant surprise. (4) The woman speaks directly to the camera, holding and demonstrating the Dyson Supersonic r hair dryer. The visual cuts between her talking head, close-ups of the product on a scale or a gray surface, and her using the device on her own hair and the dog's fur. Various black nozzle attachments are showcased individually and attached to the device.
